ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring pipeline that analyzes multi-spectral raster data to detect unauthorized industrial land expansion and thermal anomalies in restricted eco-zones.
ideas.title: AegisNode: Satellite Land Compliance & Thermal Anomaly Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the AI For Climate & Sustainability track, this project mirrors hard-engineering wins like GeoNex-ATLAS by processing real geospatial raster data rather than simple text prompts.

ideas.pitch: An investigative dashboard combining graph neural networks and LightGBM to flag complex provider-patient collusion rings and billing fraud in healthcare claims.
ideas.title: MediGraph: Graph-Powered AML and Fraud Detection for Healthcare Insurance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits directly into the AI For Healthcare track and incorporates complex graph intelligence and Focal LightGBM, adopting the deep domain architecture of winning financial AML systems.

ideas.pitch: A statistical forecasting tool utilizing Poisson generalized additive models and spatial regression to predict regional crop disease outbreaks with calibrated 90% prediction intervals.
ideas.title: AgriForecast: Poisson-GAM Crop Yield and Blight Incident Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the AI For Agriculture track, it applies rigorous statistical incident forecasting and rolling backtests instead of a generic UI wrapper, a winning formula from predictive hackathon entries.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent coordination platform that ingests unstructured emergency distress feeds, extracts actionable geo-coordinates, and prioritizes resource dispatch using deterministic risk scoring.
ideas.title: ResQ-Graph: Multi-Agent Disaster Response Logistics Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Designed for the AI For Safety & Disaster Response track, it leverages autonomous multi-agent workflows and real-time structuring of unstructured data, matching proven hackathon data design architectures.

ideas.pitch: An AI nutrition and patient onboarding platform built specifically for post-operative recovery tracking, generating tailored macronutrient meal plans and trust-building conversational intake.
ideas.title: NutriPath AI: Clinical Prosthodontic and Dietary Recovery Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the AI For Healthcare track by fusing personalized nutritional science with patient acquisition pathways, directly replicating the winning blueprint of specialized clinical AI tools.
